coaching.headline: We edged the kills 19-18 and won four fights in a row — but cashed only one, lost the majors ledger 14-29, and the base fell within a minute of the final 2-5 teamfight.
coaching.team: From 17.5 to 26 we won four straight skirmishes, all 2-1, and converted exactly one — the sheet shows 17.5, 21.5 and 23 left on the table, and even the won fight at 26 ended with our carry dead and three towers falling by 27.1. The 27.8 Primal Fangtooth teamfight was a fair trade — we lost it 2-3 but took Primal Fangtooth in the same window — though it was also taken three items down by the gold model, 9 to their 12: a timing miss, not a mechanics one. The clean losses got cashed hard: the 30.6 fight at our inner tower preceded their Orb Prime at 32.1, and the 34.2 teamfight went 2-5 with all five deaths ahead of the inhibitors and the Core at 35. Draft-and-build lesson: their damage was led by Gadget's 61k magical — magic resist was the missing answer.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Minute 30.6. A fight started at our inner tower while Mr_Meat31's Legion was pinned in a losing carry lane and the midlaner, alive, never joined — we lost it 1-2 and they cashed the window into Orb Prime at 32.1, Genesis Core at 32 and Primal Fangtooth at 33. With a lane pinned and a body not coming, the better call was to reset, hold the tower, and meet them at Orb Prime five strong; instead the 34.2 fight was played from behind on the map and the base fell by 35.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Mr_Meat31 drew one of the two paper-unfavored lanes (the jungle read against us too) — Legion into Murdock, read 'theirs all game' — and it played to script at 1/3/5. Two game reads matter more than the scoreline: his death in the won fight at 26 preceded three towers falling between 26.4 and 27.1, so a won fight that ends with the carry dead is a fight to leave a beat earlier; and at 30.6 the macro note has him pinned in a losing lane when the fight started — that one is on the fight call, not on Legion. On the build, Vanquisher was the missing core piece.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Goldilocks324's Phase won the support matchup on paper all game and backed it up — 1/1/6, 16,990 healing, and 23 wards. The one flag is the 27.8 Primal Fangtooth teamfight: the macro read has her alive and ahead in lane, and a shove-and-rotate there flips a 2-3 into a numbers advantage — a support's healing only counts in the fights she reaches. The lane was held; the next step is turning that safety into presence at the fights that decide the map.

threats: Chain-CC risk (2 hard-CC abilities, ~2.3s of lockdown): Gadget Security Gate (root 1s), Crunch Right Crunch (knockup 1.25s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Zinx. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 3 items of it.
Dive threat on our backline: Serath, Crunch. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Howitzer Land Mine (knockback). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Slow Grenades / Land Mine zone → R2000 Missile → Make It Rain ult
ourKits.winCondition: wall off space with mines/grenades and rain artillery on a held enemy
ourKits.playWith: CC and chokes that force enemies into his zones
ourKits.playAgainst: immobile turret — flank his mine zones, dive when ult is down

ourKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
ourKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
ourKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
ourKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal

ourKits.combo: Anima Burst / Whispering Echoes apply Soul Rip → Severance resets on Soul-Ripped targets → Soulstorm pulls them in
ourKits.winCondition: chain Severance resets to stick to a target and burst in melee
ourKits.passive: casting grants ranged empowered basics + attack speed
ourKits.playWith: follow-up CC to hold the target she dashes onto
ourKits.playAgainst: her chain needs Soul Rip resets — peel/disengage breaks it; punish when Severance is on cooldown

ourKits.combo: Telekinetic Link an ally → Psychic Flare blind → Energy Lance → Hyperflux buff ult
ourKits.winCondition: buff a hyper-carry through the Link and Hyperflux for a teamfight
ourKits.passive: abilities heal her and her linked ally
ourKits.playWith: the strongest carry to Link and supercharge
ourKits.playAgainst: kill the linked carry, not Phase; break the link timing

enemyKits.winCondition: keep an ally alive with Infuse + the revive ult and poke with Ricochet

enemyKits.playAgainst: she can't heal herself — dive HER; bait the revive before committing

enemyKits.combo: Ascend dive → Heaven's Fury multi-strike → Chastise slow → Heresy form ult, resets on takedowns
enemyKits.winCondition: dive the backline and snowball Heresy resets

enemyKits.playAgainst: peel the backline — deny the first kill and her resets dry up

enemyKits.combo: Security Gate root → Sticky Mine → Tesla Dome zone ult
enemyKits.winCondition: root with the gate and trap a fight inside the Tesla Dome
enemyKits.passive: FDA stacks grant scaling magical power
enemyKits.playWith: frontline that holds enemies in her Dome
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge the gate; spread vs the Dome — she's immobile, dive her

enemyKits.combo: Forward Crunch gap-close stun → Right Crunch knockup → empowered Left Crunch, sustain via Re-Crunch
enemyKits.winCondition: all-in a squishy with the empowered combo and heal back through Re-Crunch
enemyKits.passive: post-ability empowered basic that refunds cooldowns
enemyKits.playWith: peel-stripping engage so he reaches the backline
enemyKits.playAgainst: peel/CC him off — without resets he's stranded; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch

enemyKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe

enemyKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
enemyKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
enemyKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies
